findings.title: Stale Content Lacking Recent Modification Signal
findings.evidence: Detected 1 core page(s) with newest content date older than 12 months (2024) with no recent update signals.

suggested_action.summary: Publish updated dateModified metadata and refresh evergreen content to prevent generative search decay.

findings.title: Brand Entity Name Discrepancy
findings.evidence: Detected conflicting brand or organization names across Schema.org markup, page title, and headings.

suggested_action.summary: Ensure the primary brand name in Organization JSON-LD strictly matches page titles and brand headers.

findings.title: Landing Screen Missing Core Orientation Elements (Who/What/Next)
findings.evidence: Homepage landing area is missing essential visitor orientation elements: Primary H1 (Who / What), Descriptive Subhead / Value Proposition.

suggested_action.summary: Ensure the primary screenful immediately states who the brand is (H1), what it provides (subheading), and what the visitor should do next (actionable CTA).

findings.title: Text Extractability & Word Boundary Integrity
findings.evidence: Detected suspicious word-boundary collapse in extracted text (e.g. 'AboutPressCopyrightContact'). Words run together without space delimiters in DOM extraction.

suggested_action.summary: Ensure spaces or block elements separate words in HTML markup instead of relying purely on visual CSS spacing.

findings.title: Content Discoverability & Structural Sections
findings.evidence: OBSERVATION: Page contains minimal visible text (13 words extracted). INTERPRETATION: Key site content may be sparse or locked behind client-side rendering.

suggested_action.summary: RECOMMENDATION: Expose core narrative and content sections directly in static HTML markup.

findings.title: Duplicate or Conflicting Structured Data
findings.evidence: Detected conflicting property values across duplicate schema declarations for type(s): VideoObject.

suggested_action.summary: Consolidate duplicate schema declarations into a single canonical entity object.

findings.title: Deep Interior Pages Lack Breadcrumb Navigation
findings.evidence: Identified 3 interior page(s) at depth >= 2 lacking breadcrumb hierarchy or parent navigation context.

suggested_action.summary: Add BreadcrumbList schema markup and visible breadcrumb navigation on deep interior pages to improve human and AI navigational understanding.

findings.title: Heading Structure & H1 Quality
findings.evidence: No <h1> heading element was found on the page. Observed: [<body> heading elements] h1_count: 0, h1_texts: [], total_headings: 0

suggested_action.summary: Include a primary <h1> heading summarizing the main page topic.

findings.title: Schema Type Detection
findings.evidence: No explicit @type or microdata itemtype declarations were detected.

suggested_action.summary: Add explicit @type properties to JSON-LD objects.
